documentation.target_temperature_c: The project's chosen operating target within ASHRAE's recommended 18-27C range (simulated IT inlet/zone temperature).
documentation.target_temp_low: Lower bound of ASHRAE recommended thermal envelope (18C) for simulated IT inlet/zone temperature.
documentation.target_temp_high: Upper bound of ASHRAE recommended thermal envelope (27C) for simulated IT inlet/zone temperature.
documentation.operational_max_temperature_c: ASHRAE Class A2 allowable maximum (35C) for simulated IT inlet/zone temperature, functioning as the operational SLA boundary.
documentation.emergency_max_temperature_c: Project-defined simulator emergency threshold (45C) for simulated IT inlet/zone temperature, enforced by the deterministic safety shield (not a universal ASHRAE hardware-trip specification).
documentation.episode_length: 288 steps representing a 24-hour operational cycle at 5-minute intervals.
